REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - MAY 2, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Recreation Services Division, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to recreation@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1254 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to recreation@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Recreation Services Division no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

CITY OF CERRITOS
  MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  MAY 2, 2024

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.
2.  Pledge of Allegiance
  The Pledgeof Allegiancewas led by a group of students from Whitney High School.
2.  Roll Call

  PRESENT:  Commissioner Ileana Prado
  Vice Chair Pino Pathak
  Chair Pat Patnaik

  ABSENT:  Commissioner Sandra Gonzalez
  Commissioner Richard Martinez

  All Members of the Parks and Recreation Commission were declared present, except
  Commissioners Gonzalez and Martinez.

  MOTION: Chair Patnaik moved to excuse the absence of Commissioners Gonzalez
  and Martinez. Commissioner Prado seconded the motion, which carried unanimously,
  with Commissioners Gonzalez and Martinez, absent.

4.  Commission Reorganization
  Recreation Services Superintendent Sherr6 Titus declared the positions of Chair and
  Vice Chair of the Parks and Recreation Commission, vacant and called for nominations.

  Commissioner Patnaik nominated Commissioner Pathak for Chair and spoke about his
  background and experience.
  Commissioner Prado seconded the nomination.

  Commissioner Pathakwas declared Chair, which carried unanimously, with
  Commissioners Gonzalez and Martinez, absent.

  Chair Pathak called for nominations for the position of Vice Chair.

  Commissioner Patnaik nominated Commissioner Prado for Vice Chair and spoke about
  her background and experience.
  Chair Pathak seconded the nomination

  Commissioner Pradowas declared Vice Chair, which carried unanimously, with
  Commissioners Gonzalez and Martinez, absent.
 5.  Presentations

  5A.  Employee of the Month

  On behalf of the Parks and Recreation Commission, Chair Pathak recognized the
  following Employeesof the Month for:

  November 2023 :  Recreation Leader III Dustin Chagualaf
  November 2023 :  Recreation Leader IV Jason Navoa
  December 2023:  Secretary/Receptionist Cortney Mathews
  February 2024:  Senior Lifeguard Cathy Miller

  5B.  Informational Update on Recreation Services Upcoming Events and Programs

  Recreation Services Supervisor Jill Toda presented an update on Recreation Services
  events, classes and programs.

  Discussionfollowed regarding program fees.

  5C.  Informational Update on Senior Services Upcoming Events and Programs

  Community Participation Manager Chelsea Askey introduced new Senior Services
  Supervisor JesseZavala and deferred to him for a report.

  Mr. Zavala presented an update on Senior Center events, classes and programs.

  Discussionfollowed regarding the S.P.I.C.E. Program and senior supportive services.
6.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  Chair Pathak opened public comments and suggestions.

  A Cerritos resident spoke in support of opening the racquetball courts at Liberty Park
  and noted there are no other courts in the area.

  Cerritos resident Teddy Lloyd spoke about new pickleball courts at Liberty Park;
  suggestedholding a grand opening event; reported he will invite the City of Cypressto
  attend; talked about more pickleball courts on the east side; commentedon a timeline,
  Sunshine Park basketball court resurfacing and suggested restriping for pickleball at
  the same time.

  Jay Mehta advocated for pickleball and racquetball at Liberty Park; suggested other
  locations including Cerritos Park East and Heritage Park; discussed the number of
  people playing early in the morning and addressed costs and the possibility of hiring a
  pickleball instructor.

  Ms.Titus reported no written correspondencewas received by the deadline.

  There were no other public comments and Chair Pathak closed this portion of the
  meeting.

  Discussionfollowed regardinga timeline for the opening of the new pickleball courts at
  Liberty Park, the process for basketball court resurfacing, working with a design team

   and the number of pickleball courts at Liberty Park and at Don Knabe Community
  Regional Park.
7.  Approval of Minutes
  Approval of the Thursday, December 7, 2023, 7:00 p.m. Parks and Recreation
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes

  MOTION: Commissioner Patnaik moved to approve the Parks and Recreation
  Commission Regular meeting minutes of December 7, 2023, as presented. Vice Chair
  Pradoseconded the motion, which carried unanimously, with Commissioners Gonzalez
  and Martinez, absent.

8.  New and Old Business

  8A.  Informational Reviewof the Festival of Friendship held at the Los Cerritos
  Center on February 3, 2024

  Recreation Services Coordinator Sofia Taylor narrated a PowerPoint presentation with
  details of the Agenda Report.

  8B.  Evaluation of the 2024 Youth Basketball League and Awards Program

  Ms. Toda narrated a PowerPoint presentation with details of the Agenda Report.

  Membersof the Commissioncommented favorably about the program.

  8C.  Informational  Review of the Parent/Child Programs Offered by the Recreation
  Services Division

  Recreation Services Coordinator Sindy Cruz narrated a PowerPoint presentation with
  details of the Agenda Report.

9.  Communications

  9A.  Reports from the Cerritos Parks and Recreation Commissioners

  Brief reports were provided by Vice Chair Prado regarding park maintenance,
  playground equipment replacement and graffiti.

  Commissioner Patnaik spoke about addressing issues before they become a problem.

IO. Adjournment
  The meeting was adjourned at 8: 15 p.m.

  /s/Sherr6 Titus

  Secretary

  /s/Pino Pathak
